'''Dorumaa Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Wuglik]] worked for [[Intergalactic Freight]] as a cargo handler at the space port.
